eventLocation: Arignar Anna Government Boys Higher Secondary School, Walajabad
eventName: Providing sports uniforms to the players
eventDescription:
The students of Arignar Anna Government Boys Higher Secondary School, Walajabad, have won at the district-level volleyball competition and are now preparing to participate in the state-level tournament.

To encourage the students, Mr.Venkatesan, with his support, provided sports uniforms to the players and conveyed his appreciation and best wishes to them.
